The Indonesian funding clause Pasal 31 states funding comes from APBD and “sumber dana lainnya yang sah dan tidak mengikat” (other lawful, non-binding sources), without specifying international donors. The judge relied on Pasal 32(2)(f), which mentions coordinating participation of other institutions “termasuk bantuan internasional” (including international assistance), but this appears in a guidance/supervision section about coordination, not an explicit funding source commitment. Treating that as a budget/funding source is a category error; hence the false positive is due to evaluation misinterpretation.
